title: Font of Auri-El
flavorText: Nestled inside this massive stone edifice shines a glowing symbol of Auri-El, King of the Aldmer.
name: Font of Auri-El

title: Echoes of Aldmeris
flavorText: This triptych may stir ancestral memories in Mer—a longing of the soul for home. Or so the antiquarian claimed.
name: Echoes of Aldmeris

title: Mnemonic Star-Sphere
flavorText: Experts continue to deduce the purpose of this device, but for now it serves as a memorable decoration.
name: Mnemonic Star-Sphere

title: Sixth House Ritual Table
flavorText: Scholars of House Dagoth would find this ornate table both beautiful and thrilling—a marvel to admire, far away from Ordinators.
name: Sixth House Ritual Table

title: St. Nerevar, Moon-and-Star
flavorText: Behold the Champion of Azura, the Hero of Red Mountain, the Herald of the Triune Way, Saint Nerevar Moon-and-Star in all his glory from the comfort of your own home.
name: St. Nerevar, Moon-and-Star

title: Moons-Blessed Ceremonial Pool
flavorText: Khajiiti legends claim that moon sugar comes from the light of the Two Moons trapped in the blessed waters of their homeland. The wondrous twinkling of this moonpool would lead you to believe it.
name: Moons-Blessed Ceremonial Pool

title: Nisswo's Soul Tender
flavorText: This pedestal is considered sacred to the "nothing speakers" of Sithis, but it is believed to play a part in the eternal cycle of creation and destruction.
name: Nisswo's Soul Tender

title: Noble Knight's Rest
flavorText: Become the caretaker of this knight's sarcophagus and remains—but take your duties to heart lest you end up haunted!
name: Noble Knight's Rest

title: Sacred Chalice of Ysgramor
flavorText: Whether you choose to honor the Harbinger by keeping this chalice on display or by filling it with the best mead in Skyrim, it will serve you well.
name: Sacred Chalice of Ysgramor

title: Brazier of Frozen Flame
flavorText: With its dazzling mix of sapphire and silver hues, this brazier lights up dramatically with an icy blaze.
name: Brazier of Frozen Flame

title: Coil of Satakal
flavorText: Call guests to dinner with this stunning ceremonial gong. Just don't be surprised if your guests aim to consume more than what you prepared.
name: Coil of Satakal

title: The Dutiful Guar
flavorText: This guar looks so real it could draw breath, leading some to suggest the subject of this piece lies beneath the bronze.
name: The Dutiful Guar

title: Eight-Star Chandelier
flavorText: Brighten up a large space with this welkynd-stone chandelier dedicated to the blessed Eight.
name: Eight-Star Chandelier

title: Golden Idol of Morihaus
flavorText: Winged. Golden. Arresting, as the demigod himself. Kneel before this idol and pray for a fraction of his might!
name: Golden Idol of Morihaus

title: Moth Priest's Cleansing Bowl
flavorText: Don't mistake this humble bowl as a simple object of sanitation! This cleansing bowl is believed to have removed impurities from the fingers of Moth Priests before they went about reading the Elder Scrolls.
name: Moth Priest's Cleansing Bowl

title: St. Alessia, Paravant
flavorText: Paravant, meaning "The First," is a title given to Alessia, leader of the rebellion against the Ayleids. Perhaps you'll be the first to display "The First," eh?
name: St. Alessia, Paravant

title: Blessed Dais of Almalexia
flavorText: Elegant. Grand. Pointed. Much like Almalexia herself. Woe unto those who would let this blessed dais fall into dust and disuse.
name: Blessed Dais of Almalexia

title: Beacon of Tower Zero
flavorText: Long removed from the Direnni Tower, give the holy light of Ada-mantia a place to shine forth from your abode.
name: Beacon of Tower Zero

title: Ashen Infernace Gate
flavorText: Foreboding and grim, this gate emanates a sense of danger and gloom. Are you fearless or foolish enough to welcome whatever might pass through it into your home?
name: Ashen Infernace Gate

title: Cat's Eye Prism
flavorText: The strange stone on this pedestal appears to catch light as easily as it catches the eye, but how it does this remains a mystery.
name: Cat's Eye Prism

title: Moonlight Mirror
flavorText: Framed gorgeously, the moons dominate this mirror, making it more for gazing at than into.
name: Moonlight Mirror

title: Maormeri Serpent Shrine
flavorText: The Maormer are said to tame the great serpents of the sea, but while such magnificent creatures may be out of reach, this winding statue is the next best thing.
name: Maormeri Serpent Shrine

title: Daedric Pillar of Torment
flavorText: Piece of art? Or torture device? Maybe both, depending on how you choose to view it.
name: Daedric Pillar of Torment

title: Carved Whale Totem
flavorText: Crafted from opal, this whale totem expresses a sense of simple joy to some. Others, however, believe it to hold more spiritual significance.
name: Carved Whale Totem

title: Stained Glass of Lunar Phases
flavorText: The Khajiit describe the changing of the Two Moons as a graceful dance, and this stained glass window somehow captures their elegance, especially under the moonlight.
name: Stained Glass of Lunar Phases

title: Meridian Sconce
flavorText: It's said that the light of Meridia is boundless and eternal. Sadly, the candles in this majestic sconce are neither, but the impression this installation creates is long lasting.
name: Meridian Sconce

title: Jeweled Skull of Ayleid Kings
flavorText: If skulls feature prominantly in your decor, this jeweled skull can become the crowning piece of your collection.
name: Jeweled Skull of Ayleid Kings

title: Ayleid Lightwell
flavorText: Ayleids believed that four elements composed Nirn: light, earth, water, and air. Light, when used in lightwells, allowed mages to restore their energy, though this one is primarily a showpiece.
name: Ayleid Lightwell

title: Ruby Dragon Skull
flavorText: The size and luster of this ruby would be a magnificent addition to any Dragon's hoard, even if wasn't masterfully cut into their likeness.
name: Ruby Dragon Skull

title: Dwarven Puzzle Box
flavorText: Is it a toy? A vault? A piece of an even more elaborate puzzle? No one will know until someone opens it.
name: Dwarven Puzzle Box

title: Snow Treaders
enchantDescription: Adds 351 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText: These fur-lined boots combine the rugged practicality of northern footwear with the grace and precision of Elven smithing. Magic swirls in the polished metal, defending the wearer from any attempts to slow their advance.
name: Snow Treaders

setBonuses.description: (1 item) While you are in combat, you are immune to snares and immobilizations that can be cleansed, but you cannot Sprint.

traitDescription: Increases Mundus Stone effects by 9.1%.

title: Malacath's Band of Brutality
enchantDescription: Adds |cffffff169|r Stamina Recovery.
flavorText: Hands that bear this heavy, iron ring instinctively curl into fists. The sound of distant drums and crashing steel fills the ears of the wearer, imbuing them with all the bitterness of Orckind and all the strength of Malacath.
name: Malacath's Band of Brutality

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Increases your damage done by |cffffff16|r% but decreases your Critical Damage done by |cffffff50|r%.

traitDescription: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage against enemies under |cFFFFFF90|r% Health by up to |cffffff350|r.

title: Mythic Items (Greymoor)
flavorText: A bag containing the Mythic Items found in Greymoor.
name: Mythic Items (Greymoor)

title: Blood Amber
flavorText: A valuable stone from the ancient urns from a harrowstorm.
name: Blood Amber

title: Bloodlord's Embrace
enchantDescription: Adds 868 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText: A long-forgotten vampiric smith forged this vile cuirass centuries ago. Though the location of his profane forge remains a mystery, this fell armor is an enduring reminder of the vampire's dark power.
name: Bloodlord's Embrace

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Dealing damage with a Bash attack places a persistent, un-cleansable Blood Curse on an enemy. You can only have one Blood Cursed enemy at a time and dealing additional Bash damage moves the Blood Curse. When you Block a Blood Cursed enemy, restore 1605 Magicka to you. This effect can occur every |cffffff1|r second.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 4%.

title: Glorious Summerset Coffer
flavorText: This reward box might contain useful crafting materials, powerful Set Items, or even rarer treasures.
name: Glorious Summerset Coffer

title: Mammoth Cheese, Pungent
flavorText: Some folk diplomatically state that mammoth cheese is an acquired taste. Others argue that its smell is not only pervasive but even aggressive—to the point that you don't need to eat it to taste it.
name: Mammoth Cheese, Pungent

title: Statue, Vampiric Sovereign
flavorText: The vile enchantments placed upon this statue make it a grim reminder of a vampire's power. Whether cloaked in bats, imbued with dark energies, or wreathed in flame, weak-hearted mortals will never forget the sight of it.
name: Statue, Vampiric Sovereign

title: Antique Map of Western Skyrim
flavorText: Explore the regions of Western Skyrim with this masterful map. Elevations, waterways, and roads may be a tad out of date.
name: Antique Map of Western Skyrim

title: Antique Map of Coldharbour
flavorText: One might question the sanity of the cartographer of this map, but according to experts in planar travel, it's remarkably accurate.
name: Antique Map of Coldharbour

title: Antique Map of Craglorn
flavorText: The cartographer who worked on this antique map detailed the dry wastelands of Lower Craglorn and mountainous regions of Upper Craglorn with a deft hand.
name: Antique Map of Craglorn

title: Antique Map of Cyrodiil
flavorText: Though currently ravaged by war, this map of Cyrodiil gives you a picture of earlier times in this region.
name: Antique Map of Cyrodiil

title: Antique Map of the Gold Coast
flavorText: Though this antique map doesn't note it, the Gold Coast was once called the Strident Coast.
name: Antique Map of the Gold Coast

title: Antique Map of Hew's Bane
flavorText: This rare map depicts Hew's Bane, also once called Khefrem's Boot, a peninsula on the south coast of Hammerfell.
name: Antique Map of Hew's Bane

title: Ebony Fox Totem
flavorText: The mischievous fox of this totem calls to kindred spirits. Watch closely anyone drawn to it, then judge accordingly.
name: Ebony Fox Totem

title: Shrine of Boethra
flavorText: Few can resist the instinct to tuck tail and scurry from this epitome of cool, feline ferocity on display.
name: Shrine of Boethra

title: Sweet Khenarthi's Song
flavorText: The rich blues and golds of this tapestry, along with its subject matter, might just tempt you into hanging it opposite your bed, allowing it to be the first thing you see in the morning and last thing you see at night.
name: Sweet Khenarthi's Song

title: Ice Statue, Cowering Wretch
flavorText: Oh, the ignominy! To be transformed into ice while hiding in fear along the Frozen Coast! And yet, that's exactly what happened to this unfortunate soul.
name: Ice Statue, Cowering Wretch

title: Witch Pike, Quiescent
flavorText: This odd bundle of sticks, vines, and witch magic looks inert—even safely impressive—but is it?
name: Witch Pike, Quiescent

title: Doll, Heiruna
flavorText: This doll vaguely resembles a character from a popular Nord children's story, and it seeks a new home. Will you cuddle her?
name: Doll, Heiruna

title: Replica Throne of Windhelm
flavorText: Enthrone yourself like a mighty Nord with this faithful replica of the stone throne of Jorunn the Skald-King! Wisdom suggests that you shouldn't irk the High King by trying to claim his title as well.
name: Replica Throne of Windhelm

title: Greymoor Keep Banner, Hanging
flavorText: A dramatic banner representing Greymoor Keep in Blackreach, that most fabled of places.
name: Greymoor Keep Banner, Hanging

title: Karthwatch Banner, Hanging
flavorText: With its knotwork tower, the gray banner of Karthwatch symbolizes the bravery and steadfastness of the Nords who live there.
name: Karthwatch Banner, Hanging

title: Morthal Banner, Hanging
flavorText: Morthal's banner features a white triskelion on a field of gray reminiscent of its misty marshes. Whether the triskelion symbolizes the unity of the mind, body, and spirit—or something else entirely—serves as the subject of scholarly debates.
name: Morthal Banner, Hanging

title: Solitude Banner, Hanging
flavorText: Throughout Solitude's long history, it has been watched over by the wolves on its banners. Legends claim that so long as one wolf flies on the ramparts of Solitude, Mara's protective embrace will grace the city's walls.
name: Solitude Banner, Hanging

title: Kyne's Aegis Banner, Hanging
flavorText: The Mother of Nords watches over those who display this colorful banner of the Hawk Ascendant—or so popular Nord sentiment claims!
name: Kyne's Aegis Banner, Hanging

title: Nord Basket Trap, Fishing
flavorText: Though once used primarily by Nords in Western Skyrim, baskets such as this one catch fish well outside the Sea of Ghosts now.
name: Nord Basket Trap, Fishing

title: Nord Boat, Fishing
flavorText: Complete with netting and sails, this Nord fishing boat is a common sight on the Sea of Ghosts. Though many of those fisherfolk catch more than they bargained for in those treacherous waters, or so the stories tell.
name: Nord Boat, Fishing

title: The Heartland
flavorText: Bask in the beauty and grandeur of Cyrodiil and the Imperial City, unmarred by the Three Banners War.
name: The Heartland

title: Seat of the Snow Prince
flavorText: The simple lines of this stone throne offer some insight into the personality of the Snow Elf ruler who ordered its creation.
name: Seat of the Snow Prince

title: Tusks of the Orc-Father
flavorText: None who see these imposing tusks from Wrothgar on your estate can doubt your bravery. Having them is one thing. Keeping them? Another entirely.
name: Tusks of the Orc-Father

title: Stillness Everlasting Painting, Wood
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Stillness Everlasting Painting, Wood

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a standard house item.

flavorText: This is a large house item.

flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Scion's Throne Painting, Wood

title: Solitude Display Shelf, Noble Filled
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Solitude Display Shelf, Noble Filled

title: Riven King's Throne
flavorText: Add some elegance to your abode with this opulent throne from Rivenspire.
name: Riven King's Throne

title: Vampiric Column, Ancient
flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Vampiric Column, Ancient

title: Mount Pack: Hailcinder Vale Elk
flavorText: Grants the Hailcinder Vale Elk Mount Collectible. Once used, the mount is available to all characters on your account
name: Mount Pack: Hailcinder Vale Elk

title: Woodworker Survey: West Weald
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Woodworker Survey: West Weald

title: Alchemist Survey: Western Skyrim
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Alchemist Survey: Western Skyrim

title: Blacksmith Survey: Western Skyrim
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Blacksmith Survey: Western Skyrim

title: Clothier Survey: Western Skyrim
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Clothier Survey: Western Skyrim

title: Enchanter Survey: Western Skyrim
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Enchanter Survey: Western Skyrim

title: Map of Western Skyrim, Hanging
flavorText: From impressive heights to treacherous waters, the lands of Western Skyrim depicted on this map show almost invisible political boundaries as well—almost. Someone tried to hide them by mimicking the artistry of the original cartographer.
name: Map of Western Skyrim, Hanging

title: Jewelry Crafting Survey: Western Skyrim
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Jewelry Crafting Survey: Western Skyrim

title: Woodworker Survey: Western Skyrim
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Woodworker Survey: Western Skyrim

title: Stone Husk Fragment
abilityDescription: When you have at least fifty Stone Warrior Fragments: Use to consume those fragments and create a Stone Husk Target Dummy furnishing.
flavorText: A shard from a stone husk. If you collected enough of these, you could assemble one of these vessels.
name: Stone Husk Fragment

title: Gabrielle's Bottle of Proving
flavorText: This bottle was buried by Gabrielle Benele, to test fledgling Antiquarians. Though not as valuable as a proper Antiquity, it was much easier to find.
name: Gabrielle's Bottle of Proving

title: Runebox: Reach-Mage Ceremonial Skullcap
flavorText: Contains a Reach-Mage Ceremonial Skullcap. This container can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores. NOTE: Once opened, the Runebox and its contents are bound to your account.
name: Runebox: Reach-Mage Ceremonial Skullcap

title: Reach-Mage's Ferocity
abilityDescription: When you have at least twenty Arena Gladiator's Proofs: Use to consume those twenty Proofs, and create a Runebox: Reach-Mage Ceremonial Skullcap.
flavorText: Your ferocity is widely hailed as being equal to the warriors of the Reach.
name: Reach-Mage's Ferocity

title: Mythic Items
flavorText: A magic bag containing a never ending supply of Mythic Items.
name: Mythic Items

title: Tall Papa's Lamp
flavorText: The incense burned within this marvelous lamp is alleged to have guided Yokudans into transcendent experiences.
name: Tall Papa's Lamp

title: Morwha's Blessing
flavorText: The four-armed Yokudan fertility goddess Morwha stands enshrined and flanked by her winged guardians, promising prosperity to all who stand before her.
name: Morwha's Blessing

title: Greensong Gathering Circle
flavorText: With this cauldron, you can gather companions to honor the Green or simply display it as an interesting Wood Elf creation.
name: Greensong Gathering Circle

title: Altar of Celestial Convergence
flavorText: What occurs when the stars align to match the constellation at the heart of this ominous altar remains a mystery, but the sinister serpents on display conjure only catastrophe in the imagination.
name: Altar of Celestial Convergence

title: Fire Lancer Construction Crate
flavorText: This crate contains the parts necessary to construct a Fire Lancer Siege Weapon.
name: Fire Lancer Construction Crate

title: Frost Lancer Construction Crate
flavorText: This crate contains the parts necessary to construct a Frost Lancer Siege Weapon.
name: Frost Lancer Construction Crate

title: Shock Lancer Construction Crate
flavorText: This crate contains the parts necessary to construct a Shock Lancer Siege Weapon.
name: Shock Lancer Construction Crate

title: Gray Reliquary Satchel
flavorText: A burial pouch containing ancient documents that were interred with bodies of the Gray Host.
name: Gray Reliquary Satchel

title: Style Page: Maw of the Infernal Shoulder
flavorText: Use to learn the Maw of the Infernal Shoulder Outfit Style. This page can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores. This page is consumed when read, granting you the account-wide Collectible.
name: Style Page: Maw of the Infernal Shoulder

title: Style Page: Maw of the Infernal Mask
flavorText: Use to learn the Maw of the Infernal Mask Outfit Style. This page can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores. This page is consumed when read, granting you the account-wide Collectible.
name: Style Page: Maw of the Infernal Mask

title: Spring Collection Album
flavorText: A common hobby among young peasants in Western Skyrim is taking petal and fur clippings of local life during the warmer months.
name: Spring Collection Album

title: Needlepoint Hearth Motto
flavorText: The colorful threads stitched into this linen spell out a homey sentiment framed in traditional Nord art patterns.
name: Needlepoint Hearth Motto

title: Icereach Frost Charm
flavorText: Carved from the pitiless ice of the Sea of Ghosts, its enchantments prevent it from melting, but its significance is a mystery.
name: Icereach Frost Charm

title: Minotaur Horn Spigot
flavorText: Engraved with symbols of the Dreadhorn clan. This hollow horn is used to drain blood from sacrifices to Hircine.
name: Minotaur Horn Spigot

title: Hagmother Statue
flavorText: A stone carving of a Hagraven with a distended belly that could represent fertility or engorging on small children.
name: Hagmother Statue

title: Pale Man Figure
flavorText: Carved from a chalky, white stone, this figure of a gaunt man with sharp teeth and long fingers looks like it's made from snow.
name: Pale Man Figure

title: Nord Knot Puzzle
flavorText: A simple leather cord woven into a not-so-simple knot over dozens of hours, to be untangled over many dozen more.
name: Nord Knot Puzzle

title: Bar Brawl Scorecard
flavorText: Contains official Bards College rules and judging guidelines for scoring the most entertaining tavern slug outs.
name: Bar Brawl Scorecard

title: Honeycomb Checkers
flavorText: A simple game of hopping marbles over each other on a board made from a hexagonal chunk of honeycomb.
name: Honeycomb Checkers

title: Hand-Drawn Cards
flavorText: A quaint set of counterfeit Imperial playing cards made by an enterprising Nord with a knack for doodling.
name: Hand-Drawn Cards

title: Dragonshout Rules
flavorText: A pamphlet often found in raucous taverns outlining how to play a popular belching game.
name: Dragonshout Rules

title: Musky Bear Soap
flavorText: Nord soap makers often prey upon bears early in their hibernation for their wealth of fat and fragrant scent glands.
name: Musky Bear Soap

title: Portrait of Svargrim
flavorText: From a series of portraits depicting the Wolf of Solitude, commissioned to hang in official buildings throughout the realm.
name: Portrait of Svargrim

title: Illuminated Prayer to Kyne
flavorText: A traditional Nord prayer to Kyne written in flowing calligraphy and framed in gusting winds, clouds, and birds.
name: Illuminated Prayer to Kyne

title: Picture Saga of Svartr
flavorText: A biography of the first High King of Western Skyrim, written in verse and accompanied by dramatic illustrations.
name: Picture Saga of Svartr

title: Partial Visual Guide to Trolls
flavorText: This highly detailed visual record of trolls in Western Skyrim saw limited release after the predictable death of the author.
name: Partial Visual Guide to Trolls

title: Logrolf Tapestry Fragment
flavorText: Once part of a tapestry that hung in the Blue Palace during the reign of High King Logrolf, it was sundered in the schism.
name: Logrolf Tapestry Fragment

title: Conquest of the Falmer
flavorText: An erotic manuscript, once part of the Bards College collection before it was banned for obscenity by the Alessian Order.
name: Conquest of the Falmer

title: Exile's Skull Brand
flavorText: This fragment of bone once belonged to a Vampire of the Volkihar clan who had this symbol carved into their forehead and exiled.
name: Exile's Skull Brand

title: Glowing Blood Crystal
flavorText: An artificial crystal formed from blood and porous stone through alchemical means, believed to alleviate hunger in Vampires.
name: Glowing Blood Crystal

title: Dragon's Duel
flavorText: A complex game of strategy between Dragon Cults vying for power. The board and pieces are carved from semi-precious stones.
name: Dragon's Duel

title: Atmoran Axe Board
flavorText: An authentic Atmoran axe throwing game prized by purists and historians. This board is unmarred by play.
name: Atmoran Axe Board

title: Ice Marbles
flavorText: A set of large, highly polished stones used for sliding across frozen lakes. The rules are simple, but technique is everything.
name: Ice Marbles

title: Dwarf Ball
flavorText: It's unlikely that the Dwemer created this small gyro-sphere for smacking around with sticks, but Nords built a sport around it.
name: Dwarf Ball

title: Troll Jaw Comb
flavorText: Prized by warriors for appearing rugged, the literal teeth of this comb tear through the most tangled and matted hair.
name: Troll Jaw Comb

title: Horker Ivory Handled Razor
flavorText: A well-maintained steel straight razor with an elaborately carved handle made from the tusk of an adult horker.
name: Horker Ivory Handled Razor

title: Chub Loon Downfeather Puff
flavorText: This puffball is made from the extremely soft feathers shed by domesticated chub loon chicks and is used for powdering the face.
name: Chub Loon Downfeather Puff

title: Swamp Reed Hair Pins
flavorText: When properly dried, young swamp reeds create extremely smooth and flexible reeds that won't easily break or catch in hair.
name: Swamp Reed Hair Pins

title: Spriggan Beard Oil
flavorText: A small bottle of scented beard oil primarily sourced from springtime spriggans in the Shadowgreen.
name: Spriggan Beard Oil

title: Orcish Hairbrush
flavorText: Fashioned by Forge and Hearth-wives of Mor Khazgur's clan chief, all but the bristles of this brush are made from orichalcum.
name: Orcish Hairbrush

title: Brow Braiding Guide
flavorText: Few have the requisitely wooly brow line to employ this tiny metal frame, but the resulting effect is quite striking.
name: Brow Braiding Guide

title: Wolf Tooth Nails
flavorText: A set of carved and painted fingernail coverings made from dire wolf teeth. A good set can be reapplied for decades.
name: Wolf Tooth Nails

title: Morthal Reed Quills
flavorText: A bundle of easy to use and disposable alternatives to feather quills and fountain pens for scholars on the go.
name: Morthal Reed Quills

title: Mud Ink
flavorText: The dark swamp muck near Labyrinthian can be squeezed to produce a dark, watery fluid that stains much like ink. It smells.
name: Mud Ink

title: Bear Paw Paperweight
flavorText: A taxidermized Druadach Mountain bear's paw, filled with lead powder to hold down papers in the gustiest blizzard.
name: Bear Paw Paperweight

title: Coterie of Organized Scholar's Stamp
flavorText: An official seal used by the oldest scholarly society operating in Western Skyrim. They are habitually misplaced.
name: Coterie of Organized Scholar's Stamp

title: All-Weather Parchment
flavorText: This sturdy bear hide has been prepared to take ink in a process more akin to tattooing than writing.
name: All-Weather Parchment

title: Bards College Stationary
flavorText: An extremely fine grade of watermarked paper, reserved for the most prestigious staff and alumni of the school.
name: Bards College Stationary

title: Non-Reactive Ink
flavorText: Formulated by alchemists, for alchemists. Guaranteed not to emit gasses, catch fire, or explode in contact with most reagents.
name: Non-Reactive Ink

title: Horker Tusk Pen
flavorText: A burly writing utensil fit for a jarl's strong grip. At the rate most jarls write, the ink inside may be decades old.
name: Horker Tusk Pen

title: Tri-Socket Inkwell
flavorText: The ocular cavities of this juvenile troll's skull have been modified to hold ink. The stoppers are glass eyes.
name: Tri-Socket Inkwell

title: Curd Spoon
flavorText: Popular on cow and goat farms that choose to make their own cheese, the tiny holes are perfect for fishing curds out of whey.
name: Curd Spoon

title: Mudcrab Mace-Ladle
flavorText: A hefty wrought-iron ladle for serving large portions from a cauldron and smashing stubborn mudcrab shells.
name: Mudcrab Mace-Ladle

title: Blubber Masher
flavorText: Tightly woven steel wires create a fine mesh, used to break up thick sea mammal blubber for use in cooking.
name: Blubber Masher

title: Orcish Single-Tined Fork
flavorText: Some might call this oddly shaped skewer a shiv, or even a stiletto, but there's no denying its forkish qualities.
name: Orcish Single-Tined Fork

title: Stuuthrad
flavorText: Meaning "Soup's Tears," this giant, two-handed spoon was popularized by a mischievous blacksmith at Jester's Festivals.
name: Stuuthrad

title: New Life Cutlery
flavorText: A sterling silver set of dinnerware festively styled for New Life gatherings and almost never used otherwise.
name: New Life Cutlery

title: Charus Cracker Set
flavorText: Nearly identical to the tools used to pick apart mudcrabs at dinner but scaled to tangle with a bug the size of a horse.
name: Charus Cracker Set

title: Wolf Mara Figure
flavorText: This wooden figure of a naked woman partially clothed in wolf pelts bears fangs of her own, like some Atmoran stone carvings.
name: Wolf Mara Figure

title: Lunar Calendar
flavorText: This simple pocket calendar tracks the cycles of the moons. Half the days are literally scratched out.
name: Lunar Calendar

title: Totemic Wolf
flavorText: A replica of an Atmoran totem bearing the likeness of a wolf. Most are decorative, but his one smells of religious incense.
name: Totemic Wolf

title: Ragged Map of Meals
flavorText: This folded, blood-stained map seems to indicate where several large game animals have been buried in the permafrost.
name: Ragged Map of Meals

title: Gnawed Mammoth Bone
flavorText: This massive leg bone from an adult mammoth has been thoroughly worried by fierce jaws. Still rich with marrow though.
name: Gnawed Mammoth Bone

title: Reachmen Wolf-Blessing
flavorText: A sacred garland of dried roots and rare unguents given by a Reach priestess of Hircine to the Daedra's chosen hounds.
name: Reachmen Wolf-Blessing

title: Shrunken Werewolf Head
flavorText: Despite having the skull removed, this head is still the size of a normal adult wolf and has Reach glyphs painted all over it.
name: Shrunken Werewolf Head

title: Elder's Teeth
flavorText: Made from cow's teeth, elders lacking teeth use this insert to grind food into a paste.
name: Elder's Teeth

title: Slaughterfish Deboner
flavorText: When fish are more bone and teeth than meat, this hand-cranked tool grinds everything to a fine meal.
name: Slaughterfish Deboner

title: Honey Press
flavorText: Essentially a simple screw vice with a spigoted base for forcefully squeezing honey out of bulk comb.
name: Honey Press

title: Muck Pump
flavorText: Similar to a mechanical water pump, but capable of creating suction strong enough to pump marsh mud out of a sinking dwelling.
name: Muck Pump

title: Karthald Mountain Climbers
flavorText: A rapid pulley system used by the elites of the Karthwatch garrison for scaling mountains, walls, towers, mammoths, etc.
name: Karthald Mountain Climbers

title: Skooma Tusk
flavorText: This horker's tusk contains a hidden compartment that smells of skooma and mountain flower.
name: Skooma Tusk

title: Skooma Journal
flavorText: This red-hued leatherbound journal has only one entry in it: the word skooma repeated over and over again.
name: Skooma Journal

title: Lemon Skooma Balm
flavorText: This light-pink gloss comes in a metal application tube, tastes of lemons, and contains skooma as one of its ingredients.
name: Lemon Skooma Balm

title: Bent-Tail Cat Figurine
flavorText: The pointed hat on this pewter bent-tail cat figurine twists off to reveal a compartment that once contained skooma.
name: Bent-Tail Cat Figurine

title: Skooma Skeleton
flavorText: These pocket mammoth bones contain skooma in hollowed-out sections. An unusual way to smuggle the substance, yes?
name: Skooma Skeleton

title: Skoomints
flavorText: This plain metal tin contains lozenges that feature the refreshing taste of mint combined with the sweetness of skooma.
name: Skoomints

title: Skyrim Animal Carvings
flavorText: This tin box contains ten carved wooden animals native to Skyrim, including horkers and chaurus.
name: Skyrim Animal Carvings

title: Swords-and-Boards
flavorText: This clump of tangled leather cord contains tiny carved swords and shields. Their original purpose remains unknown.
name: Swords-and-Boards

title: Wooden Tool Set
flavorText: Carved from a variety of wood, this set of toy tools is meant to help young ones learn the names of wood and tools.
name: Wooden Tool Set

title: Slaughterfish Finger Puzzle
flavorText: Shaped and painted like a slaughterfish, this wicker tube traps fingers until the puzzle of how to free them is figured out.
name: Slaughterfish Finger Puzzle

title: Butterfly Dancer
flavorText: A purple fabric butterfly dances on the end of a springy wire. Small gems on its wings catch the light.
name: Butterfly Dancer

title: Toothpick Fort
flavorText: Crafted from toothpicks, this strangely sturdy, rough little fort resembles Nord strongholds from across Skyrim.
name: Toothpick Fort

title: The Lonely Troll Commemorative Plate
flavorText: This blue-and-silver plate bears a troll embossed with the words "The Lonely Troll" running along the outer rim.
name: The Lonely Troll Commemorative Plate

title: Iron Mountain Flower Trivet
flavorText: This wrought iron trivet features mountain flowers in a twining pattern flowing in a circle around the edge.
name: Iron Mountain Flower Trivet

title: Snowy Owl Platter
flavorText: Lovingly crafted from wood, this platter features three adorable snowy owl carvings jutting up from the middle.
name: Snowy Owl Platter

title: Mammoth Butter Stamp and Plate
flavorText: Both wooden stamp and plate showcase an angry mammoth, allowing hosts to provide a bread-stabbing target for irate guests.
name: Mammoth Butter Stamp and Plate

title: Silver Spiked Bowl
flavorText: The spikes decorating this silver bowl make it a lethal weapon … or an ill-advised addition to one's kitchenware.
name: Silver Spiked Bowl

title: Gold Leaf Cabbage Bowl
flavorText: This green-hued porcelain bowl is shaped like a cabbage, with delicate gold leaf providing extra detail work.
name: Gold Leaf Cabbage Bowl

title: Glowing Mushroom Vase
flavorText: Decorated with painted glowing mushrooms, this elegant vase can also hold sprigs of snowberries.
name: Glowing Mushroom Vase

title: Solitude Cabbage Collector Plate
flavorText: Designed as both an award and a dish, this silver plate proclaims the bearer to be the winning cabbage collector for 2E 574.
name: Solitude Cabbage Collector Plate

title: Solitude Service Tankard
flavorText: This pewter tankard has an inscription upon it thanking the former owner for their loyal service in the Solitude Guard.
name: Solitude Service Tankard

title: Morthal Guard Running Chant
flavorText: This ripped sheet contains a running chant with all but "Morthal" scratched out and replaced with scrawled expletives.
name: Morthal Guard Running Chant

title: Dragon Bridge Wax Seal Stamp
flavorText: Used by those assigned duty at Dragon Bridge Garrison, this wax seal stamp depicts a simple bridge icon.
name: Dragon Bridge Wax Seal Stamp

title: Sweetroll Patrol Tin
flavorText: This black tin holds a sweetroll, keeping it warm throughout an entire guard patrol. An icon of a sweetroll decorates its top.
name: Sweetroll Patrol Tin

title: Guard Duty Stones
flavorText: A leather pouch contains 30 crystal spheres of various hues, plus instructions for determining guard duty times or positions.
name: Guard Duty Stones

title: Broken Bee Smoker
flavorText: This well-used smoker contains a few hop pellets, but its bellows is full of holes.
name: Broken Bee Smoker

title: Foul Hoof Pick
flavorText: The handle on this metal hoof pick has several expletives etched into it. Or perhaps they're mount names.
name: Foul Hoof Pick

title: Mammoth Leather Cleaner
flavorText: Sliding the lid off this rectangular tin reveals a foul-smelling goop. A dead moth rests in the substance.
name: Mammoth Leather Cleaner

title: Spool of Fletching Silk
flavorText: The light silk floss on this crude spool serves to help keep fletching attached to an arrow.
name: Spool of Fletching Silk

title: Snake-Etched Prybar
flavorText: A faintly glowing slithering snake stretches across the length of this prybar.
name: Snake-Etched Prybar

title: Horker Tusk Curry Comb
flavorText: Shaped from a horker's tusk, this grooming instrument otherwise looks and works like a normal horse's curry comb.
name: Horker Tusk Curry Comb

title: Pearly White Tooth Veneer
flavorText: This tin, with a toothy horse etched on its lid, contains apple-scented sparkling powder that helps merchants sell equines.
name: Pearly White Tooth Veneer

title: Horker-Skin Mittens
flavorText: Lined with fur, these mismatched blue mittens have the words "horker skin is the best skin" branded on their palms.
name: Horker-Skin Mittens

title: Vossa-Satl Frog Treats Pouch
flavorText: Hanging from a neck cord, this pouch contains objects that wriggle and move like bugs. Are they bugs, though? Are they?
name: Vossa-Satl Frog Treats Pouch

title: Used Horker-Skin Boot Liners
flavorText: Though they smell like they visited a pigpen before being eaten and spit up by a sick Hagraven, these liners appear comfortable.
name: Used Horker-Skin Boot Liners

title: Fungal Spore Fabric Glister
flavorText: Instructions on tin: To brighten lackluster fabric, apply to garment, rub. Works well with Fungal Spore Scent Eliminator!
name: Fungal Spore Fabric Glister

title: Fungal Spore Scent Eliminator
flavorText: Instructions on tin: To remove unwanted fungal smells, apply to garment, rub briskly. Use gloves to prevent irritation.
name: Fungal Spore Scent Eliminator

title: Darkwater Pearl Eye
flavorText: This pearl naturally resembles a High Elf's eye, making it perfect for those wounded in a dueling mishap.
name: Darkwater Pearl Eye

title: Twisted Root Vial
flavorText: The roots that form this container intertwine so closely that no liquid escapes. Dried blood crusts the inside.
name: Twisted Root Vial

title: Blood-Encrusted Thorn
flavorText: This thorn, about the size of a dagger, is stained with dried blood.
name: Blood-Encrusted Thorn

title: Blood-Friend's Silken Neck Wrap
flavorText: This light and fashionable silk covers up the telltale marks of a recent (and willing) offering from a blood-friend.
name: Blood-Friend's Silken Neck Wrap

title: Dragonbone Fang Caps
flavorText: Crafted from Dragonbone, these caps fit over most vampiric fangs.
name: Dragonbone Fang Caps

title: Bloodfed Rose
flavorText: This purple-hued rose dries out when not provided with blood, yet springs to vibrant life with a single drop of crimson.
name: Bloodfed Rose

title: Crimson Rose Walking Stick
flavorText: Engraved with thorned roses, this ornate walking stick is a favored accessory among the vampire elite.
name: Crimson Rose Walking Stick

title: Feast of Souls Miniature Painting
flavorText: Vampires of all races encircle a group of willing blood-friends, some already offering necks or naked limbs.
name: Feast of Souls Miniature Painting

title: Vampiric Hourglass
flavorText: Instead of sand, fresh blood fills this hourglass, making it more of a vampiric food receptacle than useful timekeeping device.
name: Vampiric Hourglass

title: Pact of Chieftains Inkwell
flavorText: A tiny label on this common-looking inkwell states that it was one of several used to sign the Pact of Chieftains in 1E 420.
name: Pact of Chieftains Inkwell

title: Dwarven Focusing Lens
flavorText: This palm-sized focusing lens has a peculiar blue-green tint to it. Any light shining through it forms a mesmerizing pattern.
name: Dwarven Focusing Lens

title: Nordic Barnacle Scrub
flavorText: A cluster of Nordic barnacles made to exfoliate and buff pesky callouses from feet, elbows, and problem areas.
name: Nordic Barnacle Scrub

title: Bleeding Crown Rouge
flavorText: This bold pigment gets its coloring from the blood-red caps of bleeding crown mushrooms.
name: Bleeding Crown Rouge

title: Snowberry Lip Paint
flavorText: A slightly sweet, slightly tangy stain for the lips, made from the juices of snowberries.
name: Snowberry Lip Paint

title: Musk of Horker
flavorText: Perfumed oil distilled from the musk of a horker, creating a fragrance fit for only the most adventurous of noses.
name: Musk of Horker

title: Jazbay Cologne
flavorText: Opening this opaque, polished bottle releases a slightly tangy scent crafted from the once highly coveted Jazbay grapes.
name: Jazbay Cologne

title: Giant's Dander Oil
flavorText: Nords swear by this oil to relieve wind-chapped hands, especially during particularly harsh winters.
name: Giant's Dander Oil

title: Nightshade Firming Lotion
flavorText: Said to make your skin close to vampiric in perfection, though individual reactions to the toxin may vary.
name: Nightshade Firming Lotion

title: Giant's Toe Lucky Charm
flavorText: A good luck charm said to grant the wearer the strength and stamina of a Giant, though most are made from dried horker meat.
name: Giant's Toe Lucky Charm

title: Mara Temple Chimes
flavorText: Sweet sounding chimes often hung in Temples of Mara throughout Skyrim. The pleasing sound often rings at weddings.
name: Mara Temple Chimes

title: Dibellan Chalice
flavorText: A jewel-studded chalice, the stem of which is molded into the likeness of the Goddess of Beauty herself.
name: Dibellan Chalice

title: Hymn of Kyne Cloth
flavorText: A pristine prayer cloth with the words to the Hymn of Kyne meticulously stitched across it.
name: Hymn of Kyne Cloth

title: Ruby-Studded Dibella Statue
flavorText: A Dibella statue decorated with two enormous, strategically placed rubies. Rubbing them provides good luck in amorous activity.
name: Ruby-Studded Dibella Statue

title: Kyne Prayer Stone
flavorText: A smooth stone engraved with the quote: "Bless us, Kyne. May we serve you with every word."
name: Kyne Prayer Stone

title: Mother Mara Fertility Beads
flavorText: Highly sought after, these beads often decorate shrines dedicated to Mara or are worn to encourage fertility.
name: Mother Mara Fertility Beads

title: Jewel-Encrusted Dragon Cult Idol
flavorText: This elaborate Dragon carving has dark rubies for eyes and probably belonged to an illegal worshiper of Alduin.
name: Jewel-Encrusted Dragon Cult Idol

title: Slaughterfish-Scale Waterskin
flavorText: A rather stiff, scaled pouch that can be easily slung from the waist. It has an attractive silver gleam in the sun.
name: Slaughterfish-Scale Waterskin

title: Giant's Camp Goblet
flavorText: An enormous drinking goblet said to have been found in a Giant camp. Requires two hands to drink from.
name: Giant's Camp Goblet

title: Nord Travel Stein
flavorText: A sturdy drinking vessel that allows the holder to freely enjoy delicious Nordic mead no matter where their travels take them.
name: Nord Travel Stein

title: Hagraven Drinking Claw
flavorText: Though small, this hollowed-out Hagraven claw drinking vessel is said to increase the effects of whatever alcohol it contains.
name: Hagraven Drinking Claw

title: The Lonely Troll Collector's Mug
flavorText: A collector's drinking vessel from The Lonely Troll tavern in Solitude. Only 10,999 of these were ever produced.
name: The Lonely Troll Collector's Mug

title: Crystal Dibella Decanter
flavorText: This ornate decanter crafted to resemble a statue of Dibella comes complete with a flower stopper.
name: Crystal Dibella Decanter

title: Slaughterfish Egg Harvester
flavorText: A finely crafted net made from tundra cotton, useful for scooping eggs out of slaughterfish nests.
name: Slaughterfish Egg Harvester

title: Ice Cutting Bone Saw
flavorText: Practically a necessity for any Nord angler, useful for cutting away ice at popular fishing spots.
name: Ice Cutting Bone Saw

title: Ice Wraith Tooth Fishhook
flavorText: This fishhook, nearly transparent in the water, remains deadly sharp use after use.
name: Ice Wraith Tooth Fishhook

title: Tin of Snow Bear Musk
flavorText: A tin of highly sought after snow bear musk, used by seasoned anglers to repel wolves from fishing spots.
name: Tin of Snow Bear Musk

title: Nord Drinking Drum
flavorText: An instrument popular in taverns throughout Skyrim, Nords love to guzzle mead to the rhythmic beat.
name: Nord Drinking Drum

title: Horker Skin Drum
flavorText: The tough head of this drum, made from horker skin, gives the instrument a muted but resonant sound.
name: Horker Skin Drum

title: Tundra Cotton Lute Strap
flavorText: A supple fabric strap for the experienced lute player, crafted from Skyrim tundra cotton.
name: Tundra Cotton Lute Strap

title: Hymn to Kyne Sheet Music
flavorText: A pristinely maintained piece of sheet music for the Hymn to Kyne.
name: Hymn to Kyne Sheet Music

title: Etched Lute Tuning Fork
flavorText: This beautifully etched tuning fork makes any lute sound as if it were brand new.
name: Etched Lute Tuning Fork

title: Ice Wraith Teeth Harp
flavorText: Despite its chilling appearance, the melodies produced from this harp are delightfully delicate and pleasing to the ear.
name: Ice Wraith Teeth Harp

title: Sterling Silver Slide-Flute
flavorText: This flute is said to produce a note so shrill that it wards off vampires. And small children.
name: Sterling Silver Slide-Flute

title: Winter-Shoeing Kit
flavorText: A handy kit for Nords who need their horses to cross treacherous winter terrain without fear of slipping.
name: Winter-Shoeing Kit

title: Frost-Rib Traction Tools
flavorText: Useful for affixing to the bottom of a traveler's boots to provide peace of mind while trekking across perilous ice and snow.
name: Frost-Rib Traction Tools

title: Horker Call Whistle
flavorText: A whistle that mimics the call of a horker, widely used by hunters.
name: Horker Call Whistle

title: Nord Barnacle Rasp
flavorText: This rough file fashioned from a cluster of barnacles makes the perfect sharpening stone for any blade.
name: Nord Barnacle Rasp

title: Giant Bone Measuring Stick
flavorText: A measuring stick fashioned from a Giant's finger bone.
name: Giant Bone Measuring Stick

title: Snow Leopard Blade Polisher
flavorText: A worked strip of snow leopard hide, treated with slaughterfish oil to make any metal gleam.
name: Snow Leopard Blade Polisher

title: Nord Pine Sap Glue
flavorText: An unopened vial of glue made from a mixture of pine sap and boiled horker skin.
name: Nord Pine Sap Glue

title: Polished Ice Wraith Tooth Extractor
flavorText: A gleaming, surprisingly delicate tool made for extracting ice wraith teeth. Also works on hard-headed Nords with tooth pain.
name: Polished Ice Wraith Tooth Extractor

title: Meaderies We Love Poster
flavorText: The names of some of the most beloved meaderies throughout all of Skyrim decorate this elaborate poster.
name: Meaderies We Love Poster

title: Nord Insult Banner
flavorText: Banners such as this, inscribed with a common Nord insult, are often hung where disagreeable neighbors can see them.
name: Nord Insult Banner

title: Read No Further!
flavorText: A scroll emblazoned with these words in large type. Below, in smaller type, is a short, highly erotic poem involving a vampire.
name: Read No Further!

title: The Burning of King Olaf Event Schedule
flavorText: A list of activities and performances at the Bards College, leading up to the annual Burning of King Olaf celebration.
name: The Burning of King Olaf Event Schedule

title: The Life of Callisos
flavorText: A mural depicting the life of the most distinguished alumni of the Bards College, detailing his early history and travels.
name: The Life of Callisos

title: Signed Sabthar Jorck Performance Tickets
flavorText: A pair of tickets for Sabthar Jorck's monthly musical performance at The Lonely Troll tavern in Solitude.
name: Signed Sabthar Jorck Performance Tickets

title: Solitude Guard Patrol Roster
flavorText: A record of the names, ranks, and ages of Solitude's guards, circa 2E 576.
name: Solitude Guard Patrol Roster

title: Illustrated Plant Guide to Skyrim
flavorText: A detailed visual compendium of Skyrim's flora, hand-painted by the artist Tyr Skarfig.
name: Illustrated Plant Guide to Skyrim

title: Dragon Cultist Skull
flavorText: Supposedly the skull of a long dead member of the Dragon Cult that once ruled over Skyrim.
name: Dragon Cultist Skull

title: Harald Hand-Free's Stein
flavorText: Weathered by time but no less magnificent, this was purported to be a favored drinking stein of High King Harald.
name: Harald Hand-Free's Stein

title: Cheesecloth Dolly
flavorText: A style of homemade Nord doll popular among peasant families of limited means. This is one of the few made from unused cloth.
name: Cheesecloth Dolly

title: Wool Stuffed-Sheep
flavorText: This overstuffed animal hide with button eyes only vaguely resembles its namesake, but consists of sheep within and without.
name: Wool Stuffed-Sheep

title: Woolly Warrior
flavorText: While most of this doll is crafted from common textiles, it possesses an elaborately styled beard made from real mammoth hair.
name: Woolly Warrior

title: Bop-a-Barbarian
flavorText: The inflated goat bladder in the head of this crude depiction of a Reachman is surprisingly satisfying to strike.
name: Bop-a-Barbarian

title: Draugr Bandage Effigy
flavorText: A pair of enterprising tomb robbers started a cottage industry making these memorial dolls from reclaimed Draugr wrappings.
name: Draugr Bandage Effigy

title: Silken Braiding Doll
flavorText: Made from embroidered silk and a luxurious wig of real Nord hair so young children can practice their braids.
name: Silken Braiding Doll

title: Mer on a Spur
flavorText: Part pincushion, part plaything. This pointy-eared doll comes with assorted tiny, sharp objects, and a pike-stand for display.
name: Mer on a Spur

title: Reachmare Horse Blanket
flavorText: Heavy, coarse, and big enough to be a rug, this blanket was made to provide unnecessary comfort to hearty horses of the Reach.
name: Reachmare Horse Blanket

title: Festive Snow Blanket
flavorText: One side is a brightly patterned linen, the other a waterproof rubber to keep clothes dry when picnicking in the snow.
name: Festive Snow Blanket

title: Horker Beanbag Cushion
flavorText: A juvenile horker's skin, incompletely filled with dried lentils. It molds quite readily to the backside.
name: Horker Beanbag Cushion

title: Swamp Reed Place Mats
flavorText: Table setting for four commonly used in Morthal. The thin strips of reed are tough, but won't scratch your wood finish.
name: Swamp Reed Place Mats

title: Mor Khazgur Stone Pillow
flavorText: Hard granite, shaped to cradle the skull at the base of the neck, for those who enjoy the hardship of Orc life.
name: Mor Khazgur Stone Pillow

title: Snow Bear Bedsheets
flavorText: This spotless, white bearskin is intended to provide a warm base for a very large bed.
name: Snow Bear Bedsheets

title: Wolf Head Lounge Pillow
flavorText: Much of the wolf's skull is still inside this taxidermied cushion, making it far more decorative than practical.
name: Wolf Head Lounge Pillow

title: Western Kingdom Kerchief
flavorText: Made from soft silk and embroidered with gold-spun thread depicting the banners of the western holds of Skyrim.
name: Western Kingdom Kerchief

title: Troll-Mane Napkin
flavorText: While coarse, the thick, scraggly hair this napkin is woven from is incredibly durable and absorbent. Perfect for any feast.
name: Troll-Mane Napkin

title: Atmoran Hawk Whistle
flavorText: This ivory whistle lets out a true-to-life, piercing hawk cry that can be heard over a great distance.
name: Atmoran Hawk Whistle

title: Witch Nails
flavorText: Rough forged, cold-iron nails with runes stamped into the heads to prevent spellcasting when driven through a witch's hands.
name: Witch Nails

title: Box of Wood Fingers and Toes
flavorText: These prosthetics will stay affixed to the skin and even bend and flex like the original until their enchantments run dry.
name: Box of Wood Fingers and Toes

title: Pristine Snowflake
flavorText: A single flake of real snow with a beautiful pattern that will not melt, even when held over an open flame.
name: Pristine Snowflake

title: Lucky Werebear Paw
flavorText: Upon closer inspection, this paw appears to still be alive. Makes a great pocket warmer if you keep the claws trimmed.
name: Lucky Werebear Paw

title: Stalhrim Icebox
flavorText: This pocket-sized container is lined with a blueish mineral that stays cold to the touch. Perfect for preserving leftovers.
name: Stalhrim Icebox

title: Depleted Bromjunaar Stone
flavorText: Once capable of returning its bearer to the ancient capital of Skyrim, it's now only good for pointing toward the Labyrinthian.
name: Depleted Bromjunaar Stone

title: Swampfoot Powder
flavorText: This absorbent powder works wonders eliminating the stench of disease. Not so effective eliminating the disease itself.
name: Swampfoot Powder

title: Frostbite Jelly
flavorText: A very dilute mixture of fire salts and chaurus eyes that protects flesh from freezing. Waterproof, so difficult to wash off.
name: Frostbite Jelly

title: Skald's Lozenges
flavorText: A box of hard, honied candies that sooth a sore throat with medicinal extracts. Known for their popularity among performers.
name: Skald's Lozenges

title: Icepatch
flavorText: This leather eye patch has a pouch meant to hold ice over a wounded eye to reduce swelling.
name: Icepatch

title: Forester's Balm
flavorText: An ointment to treat a wide assortment of stings, bites, and irritants likely to occur in the wilds of Western Skyrim.
name: Forester's Balm

title: Mor Khazgur Tusk Tongs
flavorText: What resembles a hefty set of smithing tongs is actually a tool for extracting Orc tusks and subduing troublesome patients.
name: Mor Khazgur Tusk Tongs

title: Clever Man's Skull Awl
flavorText: Many know how to use this short spike with cushioning around its base for punching a hole in the skull. Few know why they would.
name: Clever Man's Skull Awl

title: Lumber Leg
flavorText: A log, bark and all, expertly shaped into a functional false leg, but the "stump for your stump" never caught on.
name: Lumber Leg

title: Mummified Hagraven Claw
flavorText: Many believe these hands retain the Hag's ability to bestow curses, but few Nords are willing to put it to the test.
name: Mummified Hagraven Claw

title: Deloused Reachmen Scalps
flavorText: Several trophies claimed in battle with the witchmen of the Reach. They smell strongly of lye.
name: Deloused Reachmen Scalps

title: Totemic Skull Pillar
flavorText: The skulls of each animal represented in the Atmoran pantheon, stacked and glued with resin. The Dragon is notably absent.
name: Totemic Skull Pillar

title: Replica Canopic Jar
flavorText: A burial vessel like those used by ancient Nords. Although mummification is no longer widely practiced, this one isn't empty.
name: Replica Canopic Jar

title: Framed Eyeless Face
flavorText: The pallid skin is unsettling, but the nose, mouth, and lack of eyes bear no resemblance to either Men nor Mer.
name: Framed Eyeless Face

title: Taxidermied Wolf and Suckling Cubs
flavorText: The Mother Wolf is an old symbol of prosperity in Skyrim, though she is most often not depicted so literally.
name: Taxidermied Wolf and Suckling Cubs

title: Necklace of Snow Elf Ears
flavorText: A morbid trophy from wars long past. It's the closest anyone has come to seeing a Snow Elf in generations.
name: Necklace of Snow Elf Ears

title: Watchful Draugr Head
flavorText: This mummified head always appears to be glaring at you, but the light in its eyes disappears when you meet its gaze.
name: Watchful Draugr Head

title: Battered Mauloch Statue
flavorText: It's unclear whether this chipped and cracked stone idol became so disfigured through neglect, blasphemy, or devotion.
name: Battered Mauloch Statue

title: Wicker Hircine
flavorText: A small tangle of straw and reeds bent into the shape of a stag's head. Flecks of what might be blood are spattered all over it.
name: Wicker Hircine

title: Defaced Hagmother Figurine
flavorText: Someone has intentionally carved deep gouges into this simple, clay effigy of a Hagraven.
name: Defaced Hagmother Figurine

title: White-Ash Kyne
flavorText: A depiction of the Divine Goddess of Storms carved from snow-white wood, engraved with whorls and jagged lines.
name: White-Ash Kyne

title: Guardians of the West
flavorText: One of a limited series honoring the warriors of Karthald Hold for their vigilance against the Reach.
name: Guardians of the West

title: The Wolf of Solitude
flavorText: A golden miniature of High King Svargrim in a striking battle pose. Rumor has it that Svargrim himself commissioned hundreds.
name: The Wolf of Solitude

title: The Eastern Fool
flavorText: Oppressively gaudy, this rendition of the Skald-King as a jester in a crown is crusted with small, mostly worthless gems.
name: The Eastern Fool

title: Bowl of Slaughterfish Scales
flavorText: Typically found as decoration in Morthal, bits of fruit rinds and dried petals are mixed in to cover any lingering fish smell.
name: Bowl of Slaughterfish Scales

title: Runic Teeth
flavorText: A collection of assorted animal fangs carved with various Nord runes. Using them for the purpose of fortune-telling is outlawed.
name: Runic Teeth

title: Little Glass Bears
flavorText: A menagerie of colorful bears with exaggerated proportions that make them far cuter than anything seen in Skyrim's wilderness.
name: Little Glass Bears

title: Orcish Worry stone
flavorText: Unlike typical worry stones, the Orcish variety are made from a coarse, gritty stone that is quick to build callouses.
name: Orcish Worry stone

title: Seal of Solitude
flavorText: The wolf's head symbol of Haafingar Hold wrought in silver for display on a mantle.
name: Seal of Solitude

title: Labyrinthian Pebble
flavorText: Though it bears no enchantment, small bits of the great ruin near Morthal are thought to ward away Elves.
name: Labyrinthian Pebble

title: Crystal Mountain Range
flavorText: A faithful depiction of the Druadach Mountain Range, carved from semi-precious stone.
name: Crystal Mountain Range

title: Freydis's Baby Clothes
flavorText: Freydis's possessions in Solitude were destroyed during the schism that split Skyrim, but her diminutive gowns escaped notice.
name: Freydis's Baby Clothes

title: Incomprehensible Insect-Thing
flavorText: There's enough order to the jumble of chitin to suggest it was constructed, but the artist's intentions are completely alien.
name: Incomprehensible Insect-Thing

title: Collected Writings of Archmagus Shalidor
flavorText: A comprehensive tome of works attributed to Shalidor, though scholars vehemently debate the accuracy of this claim.
name: Collected Writings of Archmagus Shalidor

title: Cartographer's Mask
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Mask collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Mask

title: Cartographer's Vest
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Coat collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Vest

title: Cartographer's Leggings
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Leggings collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Leggings

title: Cartographer's Gloves
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Gloves collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Gloves

title: Cartographer's Boots
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Boots collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Boots

title: Cartographer's Tricorn
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Belt collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Tricorn

title: Cartographer's Rucksack
flavorText: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume. Use this item to unlock the Cartographer's Backpack collectible fragment.
name: Cartographer's Rucksack

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Adds 1 Critical Chance

(2 items) Your Heavy Attacks tether you to enemies for |cffffff5|r seconds, as long as you remain within 10 meters of them. Enemies touching the tether take 1098 Physical damage every |cffffff1|r second and you gain a stack of Husk Drain, up to 15 stacks. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

When the tether ends, you consume the stacks and gain 0 Weapon and Spell Damage per stack for |cffffff5|r seconds.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 2%.

name: Lady Thorn Visage

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Adds 1 Maximum Health

(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing 4290 Disease damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by 10%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 2%.

title: Foolkiller's Ward
flavorText: A Heavy Armor set found in The Cauldron.
name: Foolkiller's Ward

title: Weapons: Foolkiller's Ward
flavorText: A Heavy Armor set found in The Cauldron.
name: Weapons: Foolkiller's Ward

title: Jewelry: Foolkiller's Ward
flavorText: A Heavy Armor set found in The Cauldron.
name: Jewelry: Foolkiller's Ward

title: Hunting Scene Scrimshaw
flavorText: Carved into a deer's shoulderblade, this image depicts a clan of Reachman hunters bringing a bear to bay.
name: Hunting Scene Scrimshaw

title: Bloodbite Tooth Stain
flavorText: In an effort to terrify their enemies, Reach warriors sometimes use this plant-based stain to dye their teeth crimson.
name: Bloodbite Tooth Stain

title: Tea Warming Contrivance
flavorText: A teacup and tea leaves are etched on the bronze Dwarven plate's top. The bottom remains cool regardless of temperature.
name: Tea Warming Contrivance

title: Stuffed Crow Rattle
flavorText: This stuffed crow body is dry and light to the touch. Small pebbles inside the bird's empty stomach make this toy quite noisy.
name: Stuffed Crow Rattle

title: Goat Skull Goblet
flavorText: Reachfolk often turn skulls into drinking vessels. This caprine cup features all the macabre details one would expect.
name: Goat Skull Goblet

title: Antler Playing Darts
flavorText: Made from sharpened deer antlers, these feathered darts are made for a simple closest-to-the-mark tossing game.
name: Antler Playing Darts

title: Soothing Crystal Stone
flavorText: A vein of purple crystal runs through this stone. Those who view it are said to experience a sense of immediate calm.
name: Soothing Crystal Stone

title: Reach Ritual Drum
flavorText: Reach witches often use crude bristle-pine drums like this to wake the spirits during bloody rituals.
name: Reach Ritual Drum

title: Vine Stripper
flavorText: This metal tool strips spines and barbs from vines, which Reachfolk use to create temporary shelters.
name: Vine Stripper

title: Ivory Sewing Needle
flavorText: Made from mammoth ivory, this sewing tool is the size of a small knife. Used for stitching rawhide or sinew in thick leather.
name: Ivory Sewing Needle

title: Witch-eye Fetish
flavorText: A leathery, mummified eyeball preserved with herbs. The more powerful the witch in life, the more prized her eyes in death.
name: Witch-eye Fetish

title: Copper Shears

title: Juniper Berry Pattern Pillow

name: Juniper Berry Pattern Pillow

title: Malachite Hairpin

title: Razortooth Manacles

title: Reach Smelting Pot
flavorText: Reachfolk use this ornate iron pot to melt down invaders' metal armor. It likely predates the first Siege of Orsinium.
name: Reach Smelting Pot

title: Wind-Up Cat Chime

name: Wind-Up Cat Chime

title: Pale Moonstone Carvings
flavorText: Smooth symbols carved from moon touched stone. They shine like bone in any light.
name: Pale Moonstone Carvings

title: Merryroot Trim
flavorText: Crafted for the inside of headgear, this gnarled root both secures items to a wearer's hair and smells like fresh rain.
name: Merryroot Trim

title: Longhouse Gold Quill Pen
flavorText: This pristine bejewelled gold writing implement bears the official seal from the reign of Durcorach.
name: Longhouse Gold Quill Pen

title: Charred Battle Trophy
flavorText: Puportedly, a piece of armor from an Imperial soldier cut down by Red Eagle and his legendary flaming sword.
name: Charred Battle Trophy

title: Elf-Biter's Collar

title: Dwarven Tonal Cascade
flavorText: "Dwemer devices are precise instruments. Usually. This, however, appears to emit tonal forces in a torrent. Catastrophically dangerous. Never turn it on. If there were a control mechanism, maybe, but I can't fathom what could tune it."—Neramo
name: Dwarven Tonal Cascade

title: Dwarven Crystal Receptacle
flavorText: Though its pronged receptacle stands empty, this pillar once housed some form of Dwarven stone or crystal.
name: Dwarven Crystal Receptacle

title: Reachwitch Protective Totem
flavorText: This totem sees use only in places where Reach clans intend to set up camp for more than a few weeks or around Markarth. Some witches claim that subversive uses for this totem abound among bloodthirstier clans.
name: Reachwitch Protective Totem

title: Reach Effigy of Turnabout
flavorText: The bones, twigs, and hide that make up this effigy all receive blood-blessings from the clan's witchfolk, who claim it sends spirits with ill intentions back to plague their erstwhile masters.
name: Reach Effigy of Turnabout

title: Falmer Totem of Dominance
flavorText: "I would ask the scholar who wrote 'I discovered Falmer mark their territory with such totems' more about this ill-scented column and these Falmer she mentions, but she died after penning this entry in her journal. How inconvenient."—Scholar Tuintaatel
name: Falmer Totem of Dominance

title: Tree, Reach Totem
flavorText: "Above us, the limbs stretch to the sky. Below us, the roots spread throughout the ground. Where both meet in this tree, place your bone offerings. Renew them with oils after every rain or the tree's spirit will seek your doom."—Reachwitch Eoinellgen
name: Tree, Reach Totem

title: Dwarven Stand, Void Crystal
flavorText: "Admittedly, I do love shiny things—perhaps too much given my time spent, ahem, among guards shall we say—but something about this stone makes me feel ill at ease. What were those barmy Dwarves up to with this?"—Gorthuth, Dwarven Ruins Delver
name: Dwarven Stand, Void Crystal

title: Dwarven Beacon, Aetheric
flavorText: "By Dagon's fiery arse, the aetheric stones in this Dwarven device simply will not budge. What are they for? Don't care. But by Zen, I can't lug this entire piece of metal out of here right now. Feh."—Gorthuth, Dwarven Ruins Delver
name: Dwarven Beacon, Aetheric

title: Dwarven Tonal Manacle
flavorText: "This Dwarven gewgaw tethers … something. Trust me, I know plenty about tethers. Can smell 'em on a guard at more than fifty paces away, and this thing reeks of tethers…manacles…that sort of thing. Let's avoid it."—Gorthuth, Dwarven Ruins Delver
name: Dwarven Tonal Manacle

flavorText: The dramatic reds and blacks of this stained glass form striking iconography, making it a must-have for any vampire seeking to decorate their sanctuary.
name: Vampiric Stained Glass

title: Red Eagle Cave Painting
flavorText: Though this cave painting stands tall, the legend of Red Eagle stands taller still among those living in the Reach … and beyond. The visceral impact of this piece may just haunt your dreams.
name: Red Eagle Cave Painting

title: Chef Arquitius's Torte Dissertation
abilityDescription: When you have a 50% AvA Skill Booster recipe scroll in your inventory: Use to transform that recipe scroll into a 100% AvA Skill Booster recipe scroll.
flavorText: This rare dissertation from legendary chef, Gratia Arquitius, details her improvements on the mysterious Colovian War Torte.
name: Chef Arquitius's Torte Dissertation

title: Antique Map of the Reach
flavorText: Reachfolk have little use for maps, knowing the land as well as they know their own bodies, so an intrepid explorer must have drafted this cartographic wonder—perfect for hanging on your wall or planning your next Reach excursion.
name: Antique Map of the Reach

title: White-Gold War Torte
abilityDescription: You gain a |cffffff150|r% experience bonus to Alliance Rank and Alliance War skill lines from all sources for |cffffff30|r minutes. The timer pauses when you are offline, and resumes when you return. This bonus is compatible with other foods or drinks.
flavorText: This consumable can be used only by players level 10 and above.
name: White-Gold War Torte

title: Mourning Dew
flavorText: This exceptionally rare ingredient is greatly prized by culinarians the world over. If prepared in the proper dish, it's said to unleash new depths of martial skill.
name: Mourning Dew

title: Chef Arquitius's Lost Thesis
abilityDescription: When you have a 100% AvA Skill Booster recipe scroll in your inventory: Use to transform that recipe scroll into a 150% AvA Skill Booster recipe scroll.
flavorText: This weathered folio contains Chef Gratia Arquitius's deepest culinary secrets. The techniques contained herein can vastly improve on the Molten War Torte.
name: Chef Arquitius's Lost Thesis

title: Ring of the Pale Order
enchantDescription: Adds |cffffff169|r Stamina Recovery.
flavorText: Bleak heraldry covers the surface of this knightly signet. Those who place it on their finger feel a cold rush of power … and a deep, nagging paranoia.
name: Ring of the Pale Order

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Restore |cffffff20|r% of the damage you deal as Health. This value is decreased by |cffffff4|r% per ally you are grouped with. You cannot be healed by anyone but yourself, your pets, or your Companions.

traitDescription: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage against enemies under |cFFFFFF90|r% Health by up to |cffffff350|r.

title: Pearls of Ehlnofey
enchantDescription: Adds |cffffff169|r Stamina Recovery.
flavorText: Even in total darkness, this string of iridescent pearls glistens like sunlight on calm seas. To wear them is to know the quiet strength of the Earthbones themselves.
name: Pearls of Ehlnofey

setBonuses.description: (1 item) When you attempt to use resources to cast a healing ability while in combat and your dominant resource is under |cffffff50|r%, gain Major Heroism for |cffffff1.5|r seconds, granting you |cffffff3|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

traitDescription: Increases Maximum Magicka by |cffffff877|r.

name: Comet, Aetherial

title: Ayleid Gate, Large

name: Ayleid Gate, Large

title: Ayleid Relief, Blessed Life-Tree
flavorText: "Each time I see the Ayleid life-tree, my heart beats faster. What treasure—what knowledge—lies deep beneath its roots? I put this relief in my home so I never forget that exhilaration!"—Theldyn Faden, Explorer
name: Ayleid Relief, Blessed Life-Tree

title: Vateshran's Perfected Shield
name: Vateshran's Perfected Shield

setBonuses.description: (2 perfected items) Adds 1 Maximum Health

(2 items) When you deal damage with Power Bash, you apply Call of the Void to yourself for |cffffff2|r seconds. Enemies within |cffffff12|r meters are immediately pulled to you.

After Call of the Void ends, you apply Major Maim to enemies in the area for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing their damage done by 10%.  This effect can occur once every |cffffff13|r seconds.

traitDescription: Increases Critical Resistance by 46 and this item takes |cffffff50|r% less durability damage.
